title.narrative: UNICEF enhanced the knowledge of 1,1 million primary caregivers of infants and young children on appropriate child feeding and care practices, contributing to reduced wasting and making a positive impact on child health and development. 2,3 million young children's immune systems were reinforced by Vitamin A supplementation, and 1.1 million children were treated for worm infestations.
